theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} : AnalyticOn ℝ (ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ) (interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)) := by
  let S := ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ
  let f := ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ
  have hS : measurable_set S := ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet_measurable_set X μ
  have hIntegrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => exp (f ω)) μ :=
    ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_cgf X μ
  have hClosed : closed S := ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet_closed X μ
  let U := interior S
  have hU : open U := by apply interior_open
  have hU_subset_S : U ⊆ S := by apply interior_subset
  let g := fun x => ∫' (exp ∘ (fun ω => x - f ω)) μ
  have hAnalytic : AnalyticOn ℝ g (interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)) :=
    by apply ProbabilityTheory.analyticOn_cgf
  apply hAnalytic
